scenario: LSER.17.2: `p25` interpolates between the two bracketing order statistics (type 7), with the rank in exact integers, and a one-sample window reads its sample. Drives the companion read `s.p25` on a logical schema into the ring-buffer percentile of both runtimes (libds `ds_series_ring_buffer_percentile`, Mercury `ds.series` `aggregate(agg_percentile(25))`). Values 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 on an `Int` slot, one per pump, each read pre-sample (LSER.8.6.1): the first read is cold and does not log; then [10] reads 10.0 (n = 1); [10, 20]: num = 25, lo = 0, frac = 25, 12.5; [10, 20, 30]: num = 50, 15.0; [10, 20, 30, 40]: num = 75, 17.5. It does not discriminate a Float floor of the rank: no rank in it is near an integer boundary.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Reading scope logical:
    dev: String key
    level: Int mutable

series Reading.level (by: dev):
    p25 sliding 1_h

rule r:
    Reading s where s.p25 is not null
->
    log info "p25 {s.p25}"
